device: Galaxy S23 Ultra, Android 16, with ARCore; app reached the API over USB
whatRan: A person spoke to the phone on a real ceiling smoke detector. ARCore ran (the app showed Spatial guidance), SAM 3.1 labels tracked the detector with estimated distances of about 30 to 46 cm, and questions carried a camera frame.

questionsOnAPlanStep.question: Is that the test button?
questionsOnAPlanStep.answer: Yes, that's your smoke detector on the ceiling. I can't clearly see a test button from this view. Point the camera closer at the center of the detector.

questionsOnAPlanStep.question: How about now?
questionsOnAPlanStep.answer: Yes, that's your smoke detector centered in view on the ceiling. It looks intact and mounted flat, not cracked or hanging loose.

questionsOnAPlanStep.question: I'm looking I just I'm looking for the test button.
questionsOnAPlanStep.answer: Yes, you found it right in the center of the view. That's the white round smoke detector on the ceiling. You can reach it standing, no ladder is needed.

questionsInJustAsk.question: Is that the test button?
questionsInJustAsk.answer: Yes, that small dark spot on the face looks like the test button. Point the camera closer to read the label around it to confirm.

questionsInJustAsk.question: Ah, thanks.
questionsInJustAsk.answer: You're welcome. I'm here if you need help testing it or checking anything else.

confirmedClaimsAsRecorded.claim: I reseated the yellow cable in part two. part two.
I plugged the yellow cable back into port two.

draftTranscriptsReadFromTheScreenRecordi: I visited the yellow cable in Port 2.
I recited the yellow cable in part two.
I recited the yellow cable in part two. part two.

voiceClaim.finding: Muse Voice misheard the word "reseated" on all three takes that used it, once as "visited" and twice as "recited"; it heard "port" as "part" twice and repeated the last words once. Simpler words came back nearly right. The person corrected the drafts in the review step before confirming; one confirmed claim still carries the repeated words.

notCommitted: The screen recordings and the frames sent with questions, because they can show the person's home.
notShown: A real repair or real equipment beyond the ceiling detector
A live equipment check: FieldProof checks were simulated
Recognition quality in a noisy site
Whether the part the answer points at is right: the model hedged, and a person decides
